```{r}
up_down <- lapply(d, function(x) { up = subset(x, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0.2 ); down = subset(x, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -0.2 )  ; return(list(up = up, down = down))} )
lapply(up_down, function(x) {return(c(nrow(x$up), nrow(x$down)))})
```

```{r}
all_ds = list(ds_KFR_IM, ds_evCC, ds_evPC, ds_gomez, ds_huang, ds_healthy, ds_wgs)
```

```{r}
breaksList = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)
new_colors = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(length(breaksList))

sites_ordered = c("Fundus","Corpus","Antrum/Corpus","Antrum","Small intestine","Right Colon", "Left Colon")
cond_ordered = c("Healthy stomach","Non-IM","IM", "Healthy intestine")

cohorts_ordered = c("This study, ex-vivo clonal","This study, ex-vivo polyclonal","Fritsche et al. ex-vivo PC","Gomez et al. biopsies","Huang et al. biopsies","Healthy_stomach","WGBS")
```

```{r}
# we assume that the annotation tables are already sorted by chromosome and CpG position
extract_subtables <- function(ds, cpgs) {
  cpg_ids = sapply(ds, function(x) {rownames(x$anno)})

  id_cnts = table(unlist(cpg_ids))
  shared_ids = names(id_cnts)[id_cnts==length(cpg_ids)]
  
  
  # row_anno = ds[[1]][["anno"]][shared_ids,]
  # row_anno = row_anno[order(row_anno$CHR, row_anno$MAPINFO),]
  # shared_ids = rownames(row_anno)
    
  sel_ids <- cpgs[cpgs %in% shared_ids]
  row_anno <- ds[[1]][["anno"]][sel_ids,]
  matrices =  lapply(ds, function(x) x[["mat"]][sel_ids,] )
  
  combined_matrices = do.call(cbind, matrices)
  
  combined_ed = do.call(rbind, lapply(ds, function(x) x[["ed"]]))
  combined_ed$Condition = factor(combined_ed$Condition, levels=cond_ordered)
  combined_ed$Cohort = factor(combined_ed$Cohort, levels=cohorts_ordered)
  combined_ed$Site = factor(combined_ed$Site, levels=sites_ordered)
  combined_ed = combined_ed[order(combined_ed$Cohort, combined_ed$Condition, combined_ed$Site, combined_ed$SampleID),]
  
  combined_matrices = combined_matrices[, combined_ed$SampleID]
  
  return(list(combined_matrices, combined_ed, row_anno))
} 
  
```

# SVD

## All up/down intestine/stomach CpGs


```{r}
hyper_cpg <- up_down$Colon_vs_StoAntrum$up$ilmn_id
hypo_cpg <- up_down$Colon_vs_StoAntrum$down$ilmn_id
rr = extract_subtables(all_ds, c(hyper_cpg, hypo_cpg))
mat = rr[[1]]
ed = rr[[2]]
anno = rr[[3]]
```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
s <- svd(mat)
gg = ed[colnames(mat), "Site"]
plot(s$v[,1], s$v[, 2], type="n")
text(s$v[,1], s$v[, 2],labels = colnames(mat), col = as.numeric(gg))
legend("topleft", legend = levels(gg), fill=1:length(levels(gg)))

```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
hyper_mat =  mat[hyper_cpg[hyper_cpg %in% rownames(mat)], ]
hypo_mat =  mat[hypo_cpg[hypo_cpg %in% rownames(mat)], ]

hypo_score = colMeans(hypo_mat)
hyper_score = colMeans(hyper_mat)

gg = ed[names(hypo_score), "Site"]

res_scores <- data.frame(hypo_score = hypo_score, hyper_score = hyper_score, Site = gg, sample=names(hypo_score))
res_scores$Cohort = ed[res_scores$sample, "Cohort"]
res_scores$Condition = ed[res_scores$sample, "Condition"]

with(res_scores, plot(hypo_score, hyper_score, type="n"))
with(res_scores, text(hypo_score, hyper_score, labels = sample, col= as.numeric(Site)) )
with(res_scores, legend("bottomleft", legend = levels(Site), fill=1:length(levels(Site))))
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
ggplot(res_scores, aes(x=Condition, fill=Cohort, y=hypo_score)) + geom_boxplot() + xlab("") + facet_wrap(~Site) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust = 1))
ggplot(res_scores, aes(x=Site, fill=Cohort, y=hyper_score)) + geom_boxplot() + xlab("") + facet_wrap(~Condition) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
ggplot(res_scores, aes(x=Condition, fill=Cohort, y=hypo_score)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge") + xlab("") + facet_wrap(~Site) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust = 1))
ggplot(res_scores, aes(x=Site, fill=Cohort, y=hyper_score)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge") + xlab("") + facet_wrap(~Condition) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust = 1))
```



```{r, fig.width=10}
tmp <- res_scores[order(res_scores$hypo_score, decreasing = T),]
barplot(tmp$hypo_score, col=as.numeric(tmp$Site), names.arg = tmp$sample, las=2)
legend("topright", legend = levels(tmp$Site), fill=1:length(unique(tmp$Site)))
barplot(tmp$hypo_score, col=as.numeric(tmp$Condition), names.arg = tmp$sample, las=2)
legend("topright", legend = levels(tmp$Condition), fill=1:length(unique(tmp$Condition)))


tmp <- res_scores[order(res_scores$hyper_score, decreasing = T),]
barplot(tmp$hyper_score, col=as.numeric(tmp$Site), names.arg = tmp$sample, las=2)
legend("topright", legend = levels(tmp$Site), fill=1:length(unique(tmp$Site)))
barplot(tmp$hyper_score, col=as.numeric(tmp$Condition), names.arg = tmp$sample, las=2)
legend("topright", legend = levels(tmp$Condition), fill=1:length(unique(tmp$Condition)))
```
